name: Mobile Defense Platform
text: At the start of the villain turn, this card deals each hero target 2 melee damage. At the end of the villain turn, if this card is in play, flip Baron Blade's character card.

name: Backlash Field
text: Whenever a hero deals damage to Baron Blade or a villain target, that hero's player discards a card.

name: Plummet the Moon
text: Baron Blade deals each hero target 4 energy damage. Destroy all hero ongoing and equipment cards.
